text:
deploybot: [PRE-FLIGHT] Private deployment for tenant Montara scheduled 2026-05-05 22:30 UTC.
Model artifact: open-redwood/titan-lite-11b@v2.0.1. Proposed pin: redwood-v2.0.1-int8 (validated in staging). Commit: d12a9f.
Proposed canary: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m shadowing during the 5% and 25% steps.
Rollback triggers: p95 latency +200ms OR request error-rate delta >0.75% OR QA mismatch >1.5%. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/montara-private-2026-05 || Release notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v2.0.1
Please acknowledge or call blockers within 2h. :calendar:

claire: ack from product. Request: pin to redwood-v2.0.1-int8 (we saw token-swap behavior on long context, added note). Customer PM asked for quiet window (22:30-23:45) and a manual approval gate before 100%.

tom: infra note 1: there's a minor network maintenance at 23:00 UTC for non-prod spine. Won't touch private tenant nodes but will run path-validation at 23:10 we normally use for post-deploy smoke. Can we move smoke to 23:20?

vik: from perf lab: int8 gives ~18% cost savings, median latency similar, but p95 varies with long sequences. Recommend first step 0.5% for 30m, then 5% 15m, 25% 10m, hold before 100% for manual QA. Also suggest disable request-level caching during canary to avoid skew.

ops-oncall: I'll take the window. Rollback time to previous artifact ~8m. Please add explicit rollback command to runbook top and list who initiates it. I'll be primary executor.

sec: security request 1: for Private deployments we need to confirm customer SSO token expiry isn't set to rotate during the night. Also there's an HSM firmware patch scheduled 2026-05-05 23:30 UTC for eu-central HSMs  we should avoid collision. I can postpone the patch for tenant Montara if needed.

customer-sre:Montara SRE here 1: confirm we prefer no HSM work during the deploy. We'll hold our own maintenance too. Please keep us in the short channel for live logs.

claire: decision: pin -> redwood-v2.0.1-int8, set first canary to 0.5% for 30m, disable request caching, enable shadowing for first two steps, and manual approval required at 25% before progressing to 100%. Ask sec to pause HSM patch.

Config to apply:
```
PATCH /tenants/montara/config
{
  "model_version": "redwood-v2.0.1-int8",
  "request_cache": false,
  "canary": { "steps_pct": [0.5, 5, 25, 100], "durations_min": [30, 15, 20, 0], "shadow_minutes": 10 },
  "manual_gate_at_pct": 25
}
```

tom: noted. I'll shift smoke run to 23:20 and reserve healthy validation nodes for the check.

vik: adding alerts and eval job:
incidents.create("montara-serving-p95", threshold_ms=220, window_min=5)
incidents.create("montara-error-delta", pct=0.75, window_min=5)
eval.compare(200, fail_if_pct>1.5)

sec: HSM patch postponed for Montara key. Confirmed. Also verified customer SSO rotation not scheduled tonight. :lock:

ops-oncall: created #deploy-montara-2026-05-05 and added oncall + customer-sre. I'll keep a short checklist in the runbook and will announce live status there.

customer-sre: good to hear, we'll be online in the channel and provide quick QA on customer-specific prompts during the 25% hold.

claire: final GO for 2026-05-05 22:30 UTC. @ops-oncall monitor latency/errors; @vik run eval comparisons; @customer-sre have QA prompts ready; @sec HSM hold confirmed.

deploybot: Schedule updated: 2026-05-05 22:30 UTC, model pinned redwood-v2.0.1-int8, initial canary 0.5%. Runbook pinned and release tag release/montara/2.0.1-int8. Status: SCHEDULED.

ops-oncall: standing by. If alerts breach we'll follow runbook: rollback to commit c9b8d0 using `deployctl rollback --tenant montara --to-commit c9b8d0` and post steps in channel.

claire: thanks team  closing thread.
